text:
Experts disagree on whether cold weather drops on MW-405 are caused by ice accumulation on the radome or power supply failure.

Erkki Expert (teams, 2024-01-18) reported that ice accumulation on the radome causes fading and drops (outcome: worked on MW-405). However, another expert view notes that extreme cold can cause the power supply (PSU) to fail even if the radome is clear (never confirmed). 

Steps to take:
1. Clear ice from the radome before touching the radio.
2. Replace the PSU if drops continue while the radome is clear.
3. Check and re-enable ATPC (automatic transmit power control), as upgrading to firmware 1.4.0 disables ATPC (confirmed on 3 devices by Jari Jänne, email, 2023-10-30).
